 Democrats weigh impeaching Health Secretary RFK Jr. over vaccine policy changes after US measles cases hit a 35-year high, risking a backlash from MAHA voters (Credit: USDAgov/Wikimedia Commons Public Domain) 
 The US has recorded 5,412 measles cases in 2026, its highest total since 1991, as Democrats weigh impeaching Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. over changes to vaccine policy.
 Democrats blame his overhaul of long-standing vaccine guidance , but some fear a full-scale attack could alienate the 'Make America Healthy Again' voters they hope to win over.
